args.summary: Deploy of v2.3.1 caused checkout-api to fail health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Post-rollback, service is healthy in all regions with error rate at ~0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure TBD.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
**Summary of actions taken:**

1. **Investigated:** v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and was failing health checks across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back:** Reverted checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent version with a healthy production history — in all production regions.
3. **Verified:** Service is now healthy in all regions with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Incident opened:** **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.
